name: Pirmasens (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Pirmasens (a red castle with a lion on white).
history: Municipal flag of Pirmasens; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Pirmasens arms — red castle with lion on white
